data.name: Gracie
data.gender_notes: Gracie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'gratia', meaning 'pleasing', 'gracious', or 'favour'. The name Gracie has been popular in English-speaking countries since the Middle Ages and has associations with kindness, faith, and humility. The name Gracie carries the meaning “Favour, Kindness, Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gracie usually hope their child will grow to embody favour, kindness, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's unending grace and favour towards us.
data.etymology: Gracie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Favour, Kindness, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gracie total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: גרייסי
in_hebrew.meaning: מתנה אלוהית, חסד אלוהים, אהבה אלוהית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גרייסי הוא שילוב של המילה העברית 'חסד' (חֶסֶד) שפירושה חסד, אהבה ורחמים אלוהיים. הוא מתאר את המתנה האלוהית של החסד והאהבה ללא תנאי. השם מופיע ברוח הרעיון של חסד אלוהים הנמצא בכתבי הקודש העבריים.

in_greek.name: Γρέισι
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Γρέισι προέρχεται ἐκ τῆς ἑλληνικῆς λέξεως 'χάρις' (χάρις), ἡ ὁποία σημαίνει χάρη, εὐμένεια καὶ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ. Εἰς τὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, ἡ λέξις αὕτη περιγράφει τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς θείας χάριτος καὶ ἀγάπης.

in_latin.name: Gracie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gracie derivatur a Latina voce 'gratia', quae gratiam seu benevolentiam Dei significat. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, nomen hoc donum Dei et gratiam eius ineffabilem repraesentabat.

in_english.name: Gracie
in_english.meaning: God's gift, divine favor, and unconditional love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gracie is derived from the Latin word 'gratia', meaning 'grace' or 'favor'. It symbolizes God's gift, divine favor, and unconditional love. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the concept of 'grace' (Hebrew: חֶסֶד, Greek: χάρις) is a central theme throughout the Scripture, emphasizing God's unmerited favor towards humanity. Historically, the name Gracie has been used in Christian traditions to signify the spiritual concept of grace and divine love.

Gracie also has associations with popular culture, such as the nickname of the famous surfer Bethany Hamilton.
data.spiritual_significance: Gracie is a name that carries deep spiritual significance. The name is derived from the Latin word 'gratia', which means 'pleasing', 'gracious', or 'favour'. In a spiritual sense, the name Gracie represents the idea of God's grace and favor upon an individual. It is a reminder of God's endless love and mercy towards us, and the importance of extending that same grace and kindness to others. Embracing the name Gracie can be a daily reminder to strive towards humility, forgiveness, and an open heart, just as God has shown to us.
